Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 370 of 2025
Applicant :- Vibhor Sahu

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Home Govt. Lko And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Kinkar Upadhyay,Jagendra

Hon'ble Manish Mathur,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.

Issue notice to opposite party No.2.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per contents of F.I.R.,the informant was allegedly deceived into investing a substantial sum of money in the business of co-accused Rahul Mishra at the instance of co-accused Shyam Ji Mishra without any return thereupon.

Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in the charges levelled against him which would be evident from a perusal of F.I.R. itself in which applicant is shown only as an employee of the said company being team leader and being present at the time of negotiations.
It is submitted that there is no specific allegation levelled against the applicant of having made any false promise.
It is also submitted that the aspect of cheating viz-a-viz breach of promise is required to be considered.
The applicant's previous criminal history of two cases has been duly explained.
It is submitted that the applicant undertakes to cooperate during course of trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed bail application with submission that applicant did not cooperate in the investigation whereafter charge sheet has been filed against him.
It is however admitted that criminal history has been explained.

Upon consideration of submissions advanced by learned counsel for parties and upon perusal of material on record, prima facie subject to evidence led in trial, it appears that there is no specific allegation levelled against the applicant of having deceived the informant into investing in the aforesaid company.
His participation appears to be the main cause of his nomination in the F.I.R.
He has undertaken to cooperate during course of trial.
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and after perusal of the record, this Court finds it to be a fit case of interim anticipatory bail.

Let the accused-applicant Vibhor Sahu as an interim measure be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the Constitution Bench judgment of Supreme Court in the case of Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicant shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of the Apex Court.

In the event of arrest, the accused-applicant shall be released forthwith in the aforesaid case crime on bail furnishing a personal bond and two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer/investigating officer/S.H.O. concerned on the following conditions:-
(i) That the accused-applicant shall cooperate in the investigation and he will not influence the witness.
The accused-applicant will remain present as and when the arresting officer/I.O./S.H.O. concerned call(s) for investigation/interrogation.
The applicant shall not leave India without previous permission of the Court.
(ii) In case of default, it would be open for the investigating agency to move application for vacation of this interim protection.
List this case on 27th May, 2025 as fresh along with service report.
